title: Chapters
desc: Add and manage the chapters in a project.
lede: Chapters are the units you narrate and assemble. Add them by pasting text or uploading files.
body:
At a glance
  • Add a chapter by upload or paste.
  • See status and stats per chapter.
  • Reorder and delete.

Adding a chapter

Paste text or upload a .txt file. Each chapter becomes its own unit of work.

Status & stats

Each chapter shows its status and basic stats so you can see what's drafted, generated, or ready to assemble.

Reorder & delete

Reorder chapters to match your book and remove any you don't need. Order carries through to assembly.
